# Audio sources

The seven SATIE object recordings are identified with hashes and licenses in `../satie/samples.json`.

`piano.mp3` is a separate CC0 recording obtained through SATIE's Freesound connector:

- Title: Lofi Piano Loop 80 BPM(2).wav
- Creator: holizna
- Source: https://freesound.org/people/holizna/sounds/629174/
- License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0)
- Bundled MP3 SHA-256: `be33ff5965d6b3d241a1336b3b4474fb62a1f5fe86ceae865b804e5458953d9c`

This recording is not SATIE generated music and is not part of the SATIE scene script.

`strings.mp3` is a quiet local mix of two existing recordings, obtained through SATIE's connected catalogs. It plays through Sound Room's Web Audio player because the connected SATIE Free plan does not provide music voices.

- Viola: "Viola C drone long" by [malupeeters](https://freesound.org/s/191344/), CC0, via SATIE Freesound. The sustained bow texture has no melodic line. Source file: `strings-viola.mp3`, SHA-256 `74971e998c161ad0769b200776b7f112a1cefcb6f9e36557d64a8004f1879461`.
- Bass: SATIE community recording `community/low-sustained-bowed-double`, generated via SATIE. Source file: `strings-bass.mp3`, SHA-256 `ab213a31fb0a75236b0e0b8ba465cfaf2fcdb2dfc37103bb3ec3975e44a2a3e7`.
- Local 90-second mix: both layers slowed to 75% tempo, viola at 30%, bowed bass at 18%, with gentle low-pass filters, two-second fade in and three-second fade out. SHA-256 `1c9b61e741a36d051dbd6ee6f105cd938d14949b79ff92923b85e17e4694567e`.

No new SATIE take was generated or purchased for this mix. The SATIE community bass recording remains subject to the account's evaluation license.
